event.title: Pacific Islands Drought
event.description: United Nations estimates as many as 4.1 million people are at risk from water shortages, food insecurity and disease across the Pacific region due to looming El Niño.

songs.intro: This album was built from NASA's EONET event list and NASA POWER weather data (pipeline/build_event_songs.py).
limits: NASA POWER values are satellite and MERRA-2 model estimates on a grid of about 50 km, not weather-station readings.

You hear the weather at -17.8°, 178.0° (Viti Levu, Fiji. EONET's area covers the whole western Pacific (mostly ocean); its only source is the ReliefWeb Fiji drought report, so we listen in Fiji), from 8 weeks before to 8 weeks after the event started. EONET gives the event's place and date only, so the event itself (fire, flood water, crop loss) is not measured here.
Weekly means of daily values; a week with fewer than 4 days of data is left silent.
Each line is scaled to its own range, so pitch shows relative change. Exact values are in the mixer and the data table.
Event from NASA EONET EONET_212 (sources: ReliefWeb).

EONET's area covers the whole western Pacific (mostly ocean); its only source is the ReliefWeb Fiji drought report, so we listen in Fiji. Averaged per week (at least 4 days needed). Event date and place from NASA EONET EONET_212. Built by pipeline/build_event_songs.py.
